READS: GitHub Pages public assets and recent workflow runs
WRITES: LAB Pages workflow trigger/verification logic, a static-artifact verifier, and LAB pipeline regression tests only.
STATE_AFFECTED: GitHub Pages artifact build identity and deployment freshness.
STORAGE_AFFECTED: GitHub Pages static artifact only; no browser storage, D1, R2, or production data.
DOMAIN_INVARIANTS: No change to POS business logic or CANON runtime.
LAB artifact must include POS/** support assets from the exact same commit.
LAB must fail closed if a referenced local asset is absent.
Pages deploy must expose the exact git SHA in the published LAB HTML.
CROSS_MODULE_IMPACT: POS/** changes now trigger a LAB Pages rebuild because LAB resolves support assets through ../../POS/.
LAB Canon Mirror CI must run the Pages regression test before merge.
GitHub Pages deployment verification prevents stale LAB/CANON comparisons.
RISKS: More POS changes will trigger Pages deploys, increasing CI frequency.
Asset URL stamping must not rewrite external CDN URLs.
Post-deploy verification must tolerate normal Pages propagation delay.
ROLLBACK: Revert the workflow/verifier PR; no product or data migration is involved.
TESTS: Run skill preflight with schema v3 and exact skill blob hashes.
Build the static Pages artifact and verify every local src/href exists.
Post-deploy verify the published SHA and critical current-head assets.
